entities.name: Vinack
entities.description: An Akroan hero on Theros who sacrificed himself to save his people, yet abused his family.

entities.name: Vinack's stepson
entities.description: Vinack's stepson, who hated him and witnessed his sacrifice.

entities.name: Vinack's wife
entities.description: A widow who married Vinack, threw him out, and later died.

entities.name: Oracle of Bones
entities.description: A minotaur oracle who killed Vinack and cast a dark spell.

entities.name: Minotaurs
entities.description: Marauders to whom the villages gave human sacrifices.

entities.name: Mogis
entities.description: God whose silhouette appeared behind the oracle.

entities.name: Pharika
entities.description: God whose cures failed to help Vinack's wife.

entities.name: Zerili
entities.description: A scholar torn apart by minotaurs.

events.summary: Vinack's wife throws him out of the farm after he beats her son.
events.quote: Vinack's wife then threw him out of the farm, aided by all the farmhands he had terrorized.

events.summary: Vinack's wife dies when her son is seventeen.
events.quote: Vinack's wife died when her son was seventeen years old.

events.summary: Vinack returns and asks his stepson for help against the minotaurs.
events.quote: Ten years later, Vinack returned to the farm.

events.summary: Vinack reveals he is the sacrifice and walks into the minotaur camp.
events.quote: Vinack strode into the middle of the minotaur camp, offering himself as tribute.

events.summary: An Oracle of Bones kills Vinack and casts a dark spell, as Mogis shimmers behind her.
events.quote: An Oracle of Bones stepped forth, and unceremoniously smashed Vinack's head in, then broke his spine.

events.summary: The stepson sneaks away; the village's blood sacrifices continue.
events.quote: Thus, the village's secret blood sacrifices would continue

relations.quote: His stepson had grown tall and strong by then, but his hatred of Vinack was unchanged.
Vinack was already a regional hero when he married a widow
